peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (41.7): 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 109 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 1 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Jul 2025–Jun 2026), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 6.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Jul 2025 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). 3 months available from Jul 2026; measurable with data to Jun 2027. Observed: 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kembangan MRT about 500 m, Eunos MRT about 970 m; closer than 263 of 462 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Stephen's School about 690 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 770 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Eunos Crescent Blk 4a about 890 m; nearest park Telok Kurau Park about 220 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 390 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 600 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 680 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 910 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,020 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,780 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,950 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 2,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 379 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 255 new sales and 864 resales (1,119 purchases); new sales were 22.8% of these purchases. Subsales (6) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 864 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 366 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 864 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 954 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.4%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
